subject.title: Feature: Per-mention model routing + context window for group mentions

question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off WhatsApp/group mention-routing mode that can process unmentioned group traffic with a background model and route mentioned turns to a separate model?
rationale: Automation can prove the current gap, but it cannot choose the consent, provider-exposure, retention, and model-precedence contract for shared-room messages.

options.title: Sponsor a default-off design
options.body: Approve a maintainer-owned design with explicit consent/provider exposure, per-group context limits, model precedence, schema/docs/tests, and a safe upgrade story.

options.title: Limit this to mention context only
options.body: Defer background-model processing and implement only configurable pending-history context for mentioned turns to reduce provider-exposure risk.

options.title: Keep it behind plugin/API design
options.body: Do not add core config yet; first settle whether a trusted pre-gating plugin/API hook such as inbound_observed should own passive observation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a default-off design
recommendation.body: Approve a maintainer-owned design with explicit consent/provider exposure, per-group context limits, model precedence, schema/docs/tests, and a safe upgrade story.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest current evidence across prior review, channel model override history, and adjacent config/security design work.
